description: This file implements an in-memory sliding-window rate limiter for gateway authentication attempts, including configuration options, rate limit checking, failure recording, reset, pruning, and disposal methods.

methods.name: normalizeRateLimitClientIp
methods.description: Canonicalizes client IPs for consistent rate limiting representation, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 forms.

methods.name: createAuthRateLimiter
methods.description: Creates and returns an in-memory rate limiter instance with configurable parameters.
